jobs.description:
For our client, a well-known company in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER.

Do you enjoy variety in your job and do you like renovation work? Then you are the person we are looking for!

As a RENOVATION WORKER in the VEURNE region, your day will look like this:

  • Together with your colleagues, you will carry out demolition and repair work as part of renovation projects;
  • Carrying out general renovation works on houses and buildings;
  • Demolition works and preparing the construction site;
  • Bricklaying, plastering and small concrete works;
  • Installing and repairing floors and walls;
  • Installing insulation and drywall/plasterboard;
  • Ensuring that the entire renovation project is completed to a high standard;
  • Ensuring that structural works and stability requirements are properly taken into account.
As a RENOVATION WORKER in VEURNE, you have the following qualities:

  • You have solid work experience as a renovation worker and are fully familiar with flooring, carpentry, bricklaying, etc.;
  • You have a category B driving licence;
  • The starting location is Bruges (Blauwe-Toren), at the company’s warehouse;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You are not afraid of heights.

Interested?
Send your CV to Eeklo@absolutejobs.be

What do we expect from you?

For our client, a family-run and growing company based in IZEGEM, we are looking for a production worker to strengthen the team. Do you enjoy working with fresh products, are you precise, and not afraid to work in a cooled environment? Then keep reading!

• Working according to hygiene and quality standards

Working hours (full-time):
 

 
• Monday: off
 
• Tuesday to Friday: 7:00 AM – 1:00 PM and 1:30 PM – 4:00 PM
 
• Saturday: 6:00 AM – 12:25 PM 

 
• You speak Dutch or English

• Maintaining a clean and hygienic work environment.

• You are comfortable with physical work and enjoy staying active.

• You speak English or Dutch.

You will be responsible for:
 

 
• Moving and dragging foam blocks
 
• Manually feeding the machine
 
• Picking up foam scraps from the floor
 
• Keeping the workplace clean and organized
 
• Working together with your colleague to ensure a smooth production process 

 
• You speak Dutch or English.
 
• You are physically strong and enjoy active work.
 
• You can perform repetitive tasks accurately.
 
• You enjoy working together with a colleague.
 
• Experience is not required; motivation is more important.
 
• You can work in a day shift, and when production volumes increase, you are willing to work in a 2-shift system.

What does the role involve?
 

 
• As an operator, you are responsible for the accurate execution of production processes.
 
• You precisely measure materials.
 
• You perform calculations and ensure everything runs according to plan.
 
• You work in an environment where quality and precision are key. 

Profile – What do we expect from you?
 

 
• Strong numerical skills and the ability to measure accurately.
 
• Good spatial awareness.
 
• Fluency in Dutch or very good proficiency in English.
 
• Flexibility: you work in day shifts, but are willing to switch to a two-shift system during peak workload.

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Third Party Risk Assessor
jobs.description:
We are partnering with our client, a leading organisation in the banking sector, to recruit an experienced IT & Cyber Third Party Risk Assessor for their Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) team. In this strategic role, you will safeguard our client's operations by assessing and managing IT and cyber risks related to external vendors and intragroup providers, with a strong focus on cloud services and key technology partners.
Working Model

 
• 50% onsite in Brussels

 
• 50% remote

 

If this aligns with your profile in information security and cyber risk, we would welcome a discussion about joining our client's team.

To find out more about Huxley please visit www.huxley.com

 
• Third-Party IT & Security Assessments - Conduct due diligence, evaluate controls and ensure suppliers meet security and regulatory expectations.

 
• Cloud Security (SaaS, IaaS, PaaS) - Assess cloud solutions and providers, reviewing architectures and risk mitigations.

 
• Vulnerability Management & Penetration Testing - Analyse reports, challenge remediation plans and track closure of critical findings.

 
• Application Security - Identify and assess application-related risks and ensure appropriate security measures.

 
• Risk & Control Frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, OWASP) - Apply recognised standards to structure assessments and recommendations.

 
• Contractual IT & Cyber Clauses - Review and negotiate security clauses with Procurement and Legal to embed robust protections.

 
• Audit & GRC Practices - Coordinate supplier audits, use GRC tools (e.g. ServiceNow) and support continuous monitoring.

 
• Stakeholder Management - Collaborate with cyber defense, security architects, continuity experts, DPOs, and business teams.

 
• Soft Skills - Strong analytical capabilities, clear communication, structured approach, negotiation skills, and ability to coach and influence across our client's team.

 
• Languages - French and English are mandatory Dutch is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Join Our Team as an Order Picker Warehouse Associate – Start Immediately in a Dynamic Environment!
jobs.description:
As an order picker warehouse associate, you play a key role in the warehouse operation. You will operate a high-level order picker truck (VNA), allowing you to safely pick products from elevated racks. Using a handheld scanner, you accurately check locations, quantities, and the correctness of orders. Your effort ensures that customers receive the right products on time and keeps the logistics process running smoothly.

On a typical workday, you collect customer orders by picking products from various warehouse locations. You work closely with colleagues, strictly follow safety instructions, and keep your workspace clean. You check products for damage or missing items and report these to the team leader. Packing and preparing orders for shipment is also part of your tasks, ensuring everything is ready to go out to customers efficiently.

Are you physically fit, detail-oriented, and do you enjoy a varied job in logistics? Apply today and make a difference in a close-knit team where collaboration and safety are essential.

• Previous experience as an order picker or warehouse associate is a plus.
• Certificate of good conduct (criminal record certificate) required.
• License or certificate for high-level order picker truck is an advantage.
• English speaking skills at level 3/5 (for effective communication and understanding instructions).
• Good physical fitness: able to stand, walk, and lift up to 17 kg.
• Accurate, responsible, and able to work safely in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.occupation: Inside Sales Representative (English + East EU language)

jobs.occupation: English-speaking CE truck driver - no experience required!
jobs.description:
Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Between 5 to 15 stops/day
• Never on weekends or on holidays
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!
